notes.title: Update 0.3 is live!
notes.content:
Thanks a lot for your feedback, I've just published an update fixing collisions  and some other bugs. I also improved sprites as well!

The achievement system is the same as before, click on the buttons to get them.


 Button: 1k -> 1-1k
 Button: 2k -> 1.1k - 2k
 Button: 3k -> 2.1 - 3k
 Button: 4k -> 3.1 - 4k
 Button: 5k -> 4.1 - 5k


If you find any bugs or problems, post it in discussions and I'll solve them as soon as possible.

Thanks again!

notes.title: Update 0.2 - Achievements can be unlocked without having to idle!
notes.content:
- Idling isn't required anymore, just go to "Achieves" and press each button to get all achievements.

- Buttom 1k
0-1k ach

- Buttom 2k
1k-2k ach

- Buttom 3k
2k-3k ach

- Buttom 4k
3k-4k ach

- Buttom 5k
4k-5k ach
